events.name: Australia v England — First T20 International
events.selectedSentence: Three days after the ODI finale, Australia and England restart the rivalry at the MCG in a five-match T20 series.
events.fullSpiel: The MCG opener asks both sides to change personnel and tempo almost immediately after Hobart. With five matches across 12 days, the first result shapes a longer tactical series rather than a one-off night, and gives the earliest evidence of which white-ball lessons travel between formats.
